content.short: UPYO is the world's largest NFT marketplace in the Middle East that lets everyone trade rare NFTs.
content.description: UPYO enables secure trading of collectibles, metaverse lands, wearables, and domain names, with a mission to make NFTs accessible to everyone, from first-time buyers to seasoned enthusiasts. The platform partners with popular artists to deliver high‑quality NFTs that are exclusively listed on UPYO, creating a curated selection for the community. For minting, UPYO leverages blockchain networks including Binance and Ethereum, supporting cross‑chain activity and broad reach for creators and collectors alike.
